drafts.name: 1A v1
drafts.notes: v1 — drone version. Too much like a car commercial, keeping crane.

shots.name: 1A
shots.notes: Opening. Crane down off the sodium light onto MAYA getting out of the car. Hold wide long enough to read the empty lot.

shots.name: 1B
shots.notes: Steadicam behind Maya, she walks into DEX. Keep his truck in frame left.

shots.name: 1C
shots.notes: Dex CU — slow push as he clocks her. 50 → 65mm?

shots.name: 1D
shots.notes: REV on Maya. Match eyeline from 1C.

drafts.name: 2A v1
drafts.notes: Arc version — nice but fights the dialogue.

shots.name: 2A
shots.notes: Master two-shot from the aisle. Cam B on the long lens through the window for the cutaway.

shots.name: 2B
shots.notes: OTS Maya → Eli. Keep the coffee in the foreground, it pays off in sc 6.

shots.name: 2C
shots.notes: OTS Eli → Maya (REV of 2B).

shots.name: 2D
shots.notes: Insert: Rosa tops up the coffee. Optional.

shots.name: 3A
shots.notes: Lead Maya down the alley — handheld, 24mm, stay ahead of her.

shots.name: 3B
shots.notes: Profile track through the crates.

shots.name: 3C
shots.notes: Low wide at the fence — she vaults over camera. Need the exact vault mark.

shots.name: 4A
shots.notes: Oner. Orbit around the fight, land on Kovac going down. Choreo from the Choreographer (brawl, seed locked).

shots.name: 4B
shots.notes: Punch-in on the haymaker. Very shaky.

shots.name: 4C
shots.notes: Maya POV-ish: hiding behind the scaffold, long lens.

shots.name: 4D
shots.notes: Alt ending uses the "Dex loses" take. Waiting on notes from Priya before deleting.

shots.name: 5A
shots.notes: Wide establishing — city lights coming on. Golden-hour sky is too warm, try blue hour (done).

shots.name: 5B
shots.notes: Eli's line: "You don't get the tide back."

shots.name: 6A
shots.notes: Dance floor reveal. 98 bpm — music cue TBD.

shots.name: 6B
shots.notes: Maya cuts through the dancers toward Kovac.

shots.name: 6D
shots.notes: Vertical cut for the teaser.

scenes.name: EXT. NORTH JETTY BEACH – GOLDEN HOUR

shots.name: 7A
shots.notes: FINAL SHOT. Rise up and away as she reaches the rocks. Seedance 15s max — trimmed to 14.

shots.name: 7C
shots.notes: Long lens silhouette against the sun.
